question: What is included in the Inspect and Adapt agenda? A. ART Backlog refinement B. Quantitative and qualitative measurement C. System Demo D. Management review and confidence vote
Which of the following events shows how well the ART is progressing toward meeting the PI Objectives? A. PO Sync B. Inspect and Adapt C. Backlog Refinement D. PI Planning
What is one influence on Solution and PI Roadmaps? A. Market dynamics B. ART capacity C. Value Streams D. Customer-centric Features
What is a pattern for splitting Features into Stories? A. Variations in data B. Tasks to complete C. Layers of the technology stack D. Team skills
What makes value available when it's needed? A. Infrastructure B. Continuous Deployment C. DevOps D. Release on Demand
Which is developed by teams and rolled up to the ART level during PI Planning? A. Milestones B. PI Objectives C. Dependencies D. ART PI Risks

When should Agile Teams make time for innovation? A. Continuously throughout the PI B. During the Innovation and Planning Iteration C. When there are Enabler Stories in the Backlog D. At a consistent time each day during the Iteration
What is one method for designing the end-to-end Customer experience? A. Persona development B. Feature storming C. Journey mapping D. Whole-product thinking
What is one tool that visualizes Features representing a workflow? A. Story Maps B. Team Kanban C. Continuous Delivery Pipeline D. User Experience Design

What is one strategy for managing complex critical path challenges? A. Distribute work to other teams B. Sequence work to eliminate same Iteration dependencies C. Adjust work between teams or split Features and Stories D. Allocate work between teams based on forecasted capacity

Which statement describes a mitigated ART PI Risk? A. There is a strategy to adjust the plan as necessary B. Nothing more can be done, so if a risk occurs, release may be compromised C. Someone has taken the responsibility of the risk D. The risk has been addressed and is no longer a concern
What is a PI Planning input that demonstrates how Product Management plans to accomplish the Vision? A. The top ten Features B. The ART planning board C. The business context D. The Team Backlog
What is defined as a product, service, or system delivered to the Customer? A. Epic B. Solution C. Capability D. Value

What is the primary purpose of PO Sync? A. To assess progress of the PI and adjust scope and priority as needed B. To conduct backlog refinement C. To build PI Objectives and improve alignment D. To align with Coach Sync participants on the status of the PI

What is essential when communicating the Vision? A. The importance of non-functional requirements B. The importance of Value Stream Management (VSM) C. The importance of empathy interviews D. The importance of Lean budget Guardrails
